Message.MsgText: Could not read object from storage. The error is: exception

Explanation.p: This is an internal error. An error occurred while reading an object from storage.

Message.MsgText: Could not write object Java object to storage. The error is: exception

Explanation.p: This is an internal error. An error occurred while writing an object to storage.

OperatorResponse.p: See error message. Contact IBM support.

Message.MsgText: The storage location folder name does not exist and could not be created.

Explanation.p: The configured storage folder does not exist. An attempt to create it was unsuccessful.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the configuration is correct.

Message.MsgText: The storage location file name exists but is not a folder.

Explanation.p: The storage location must be a folder.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the configuration is correct.

Message.MsgText: Could not read the value for key key name from file file name. The error is: exception

Explanation.p: The storage file which holds the value for the specified key could not be read.

OperatorResponse.p: See error message. Check the file system permissions.

Message.MsgText: Could not create folders for path folder path.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism could not create file system directory structure.

Message.MsgText: file name already exists and is not a folder.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism expects that the specified file is a folder.

Message.MsgText: Could not write to file file name. The error is: exception

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism could not write data to the specified file.
The storage mechanism cannot work with empty keys.

Message.MsgText: Key must not be a single slash.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a key to be a single slash.

Message.MsgText: Key must not be contain consecutive slashes: key name.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a key to contain consecutive slashes.

Message.MsgText: Key must not contain back slashes: key name.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a key to contain back slashes.

Message.MsgText: Key must not contain curly brackets: key name.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a key to contain curly brackets.

Message.MsgText: Component of a key must not be a single dot: key component.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a component of a key to be a single dot.

Message.MsgText: Component of a key must not be double dots: key component.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a component of a key to be double dots.

Message.MsgText: Could not delete file file name.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism failed to delete the specified file.
